title: Structure envelope v1
description: GET /api/products/{slug}/structure: the product's app-structure map, its events and their fingerprint. The same shape answers a live product and the built-in Kettle sample.

events.description: events.jsonl as text, one app-structure-event per line; '' when the product has none.

rev.description: The fingerprint of the map and the events; the SSE `map` event carries the same value when either changes, and the plan route answers the same rev.
